sourceNotes: 计时弹窗新增时区页，并提供中号桌面时区小组件
Finder 新建文档改为随机生成 8 位字母数字或 UUID 文件名，移除固定命名与手动输入
Finder 新建文档菜单显示对应格式图标，完善 Keynote 与 Numbers 安装识别

en: Add a time zone page to the timer popover and a medium desktop widget showing local, UTC, and US Pacific dates and times. The local time zone name follows system settings, and Pacific time adjusts automatically for daylight saving time.
Use random 8-character alphanumeric strings or UUIDs for new Finder document names, replacing fixed names and manual input.
Show file format icons in the Finder document menu, improve detection of installed Keynote and Numbers apps, and show the settings button only while the feature is enabled.
